content: Dawita Sheeshi
Kebroona kataman Dawiti yelida nayti haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysata; Izira7eele maccase Aknahoomipe yelida bayra na7ay Amnoona. Qarmeloosa maccase Abigiyape yelida nam7antho na7ay Daanela.
Geshura kawa Talmaya na7iya Ma7ika yelida heedzantho na7ay Abeseloome. Agita yelida oyddantho na7ay Adoniyaasa.
Abixaala yelida ichashantho na7ay Safaaxa. Egila yelida usupuntho na7ay Yitirhaama.
Dawiti ha usupun nayta Kebroonan yelis. Dawiti Kebroonan laapun laythinne usupun ageena kawotis. Yerusalaamen hastamanne heedzu laythi kawotis.
Dawiti Yerusalaamen Ami7eela na7e Barsaabepe yelida oyddu nayti Saamusa, Sobaaba, Naatanenne Solomone.
Qassi hara uddufun adde nayti Iyabhaara, Elishu7a, Elfalaxa,
Noga, Nefeqa, Yafaya,
Elsama, Eldahenne Elfalaxa.
Ha adde nayta ubbaa bolla Dawitas laggethotape yeletida hara adde nayti de7oosona; Timaaro geetetiya micha entaw de7awusu.
Yihuda Kawota
Kawa Solomone yeletay haysafe kaallidi xaafetidaysa. Solomone na7ay Orobi7aama; Orobi7aama na7ay Abiya; Abiya na7ay Asa; Asa na7ay Iyosaafexa;
Iyosaafexa na7ay Iyoraama; Iyoraama na7ay Akaziyaasa; Akaziyaasa na7ay Iyo7aasa;
Iyo7aasa na7ay Amasiyaasa; Amasiyaasa na7ay Azaariyasa; Azaariyasa na7ay Iyo7atama;
Iyo7atama na7ay Akaaza; Akaaza na7ay Hizqiyaasa; Hizqiyaasa na7ay Minaase;
Minaase na7ay Amoxe; Amoxe na7ay Iyosyaasa.
Iyosyaasa na7ay bayray Yohaanana; nam7anthoy Iyo7aaqeme; heedzanthoy Sedeqiyaasa; oyddanthoy Salooma.
Iyo7aaqeme nayti Ikoniyaananne Sedeqiyaasa.
Kawota Yeleta Susa
Di7etidi Babiloone bida Ikoniyaana adde nayti Salatiyaala,
Malkiraama, Padaya, Shenaxaara, Yiqaama, Hoshamanne Nadaaba.
Padaya adde nayti Zarubaabelanne Same7a. Zarubaabela adde nayti Masulaamanne Hanaana; enta michiya Salomito.
Hayisata bolla hara ichashu adde nayti Zarubaabelas de7oosona; entika Hashuba, Oheela, Baraka, Hasadiyanne Yoshab-Heseda.
Hanaana adde nayti Palaxanne Yeshaya. Yeshaya na7ay Rafaya; Rafaya na7ay Arnaana; Arnaana na7ay Abdiyu; Abdiyu na7ay Sakana;
Sakana na7ay Shamaya. Shamaya nayti ichashati Haxusa, Yigi7aala, Bariha, Na7aranne Shaafaxa.
Na7ara nayti heedzati Eliyo7ana, Hizqiyaasanne Aziriqaama.
Eliyo7ana nayti laapunati Hodawa, Eliyaseeba, Palaya, Aquba, Yohaanana, Dalayanne Aneena.
